summary: After a teachers' strike ends with a raise, parents who pulled their children out and angry residents keep pressing the school board.
realLife: After a 23-day strike in Oakland in 1996, teachers got a raise of roughly 22 percent, many families had moved children to private schools, and a recall effort was under way.
sources: Education Week, Pact Ending Strike Brings Fragile Peace: https://www.edweek.org/teaching-learning/pact-ending-strike-brings-fragile-peace/1996/03
inGame: strike formed by the public-action engine ends in a contract; parents' school records and neighbor ties carry the split.

turns.summary: Families come back as the district communicates.
Angry parents press a recall of board members.
turns.writesBack: cause shared among neighbors; invitation to a meeting

turns.summary: The union says the deal is only a base for later bargaining.
